tools.name: search_assets
tools.description: Search free Web3 icons, illustrations, and animations by topic. Returns source URLs, measurable embed URLs, creator, and license.

tools.name: get_asset
tools.description: Get exact metadata and source URLs for one published Web3icon asset.

tools.name: get_embed_code
tools.description: Create an HTML, Markdown, or URL embed for a published asset. The embed URL helps Yuhitsuro measure real-world adoption.

tools.name: request_asset
tools.description: Request a Web3 icon, illustration, or animation that is missing from the catalog. Use this after search_assets returns no suitable result. Do not include contact details, URLs, wallet addresses, or private data.
